title: ToolRegistry.getSchemas(mode) 필터링 구현
description: ToolRegistry 클래스: registerTool(tool), getSchemas(mode) → mode 허용 도구만 필터링하여 OpenAI function calling 스키마 배열 반환. ToolDefinition: name, description, parameters(ZodSchema), modeAllowlist(string[]). 카테고리: search, edit, terminal, web, session, orchestration, debug. 메타데이터: uiGroup, requiresApproval, destructive.
acceptanceCriteria: Zod 스키마 → JSON Schema 변환 정확
